policy_note: CLI is a binary crate with most code under `commands/` doing CLI parsing, dispatch, or I/O against live models/servers. This policy is scoped to the `bench/` and `dec_bench/` subtrees: pure helpers are gated at the 90% default; I/O-wrapper runtime files (`*_runtime.rs`) and the top-level orchestrators (`run.rs`, `mod.rs`, `args.rs`) are excluded because they're thin glue around `larql_inference` / `larql_compute` / `LayerShardedBackend` / `RemoteMoeBackend` / `reqwest` calls that need live shards and real model weights to exercise. The split keeps every byte of testable post-processing logic under the gate. Baseline measured 2026-05-15; dec_bench added 2026-07-22. 2026-09-03 (optimizer MCP facade, stage 4): the `optimizer_mcp/` subtree is brought UNDER the gate rather than left outside it — protocol.rs and tools.rs at 100%, server.rs at 97.2%, all measured against the real Rung 5 record. The one baseline entry is mod.rs: `run` locks the process's own stdin and stdout, so its six lines cannot be reached in-process. Everything below it was split out as `dispatch`/`declare`/`serve`/`load`, which take their reader and writer and are driven end to end from a record on disk. Raise this if `run` ever grows logic; it should not. 2026-09-05 (K3 residency vertical): `vindex3_cmd/realizations.rs` — the prepare-only admission report, pure presentation over `select_realizations` and `expectations` — is brought UNDER the gate at the 90% default and driven end to end from an encoded fixture (within budget, over budget, machine budget, a registry that refuses); the rest of `vindex3_cmd/` stays outside as live-model I/O glue. 2026-11-06 (hf:// first-run encode): `hf_auto/` is brought UNDER the gate at the 90% default — store, classify, resolve, refusal and encode are driven without a network through an injected probe and encoder (encode.rs end to end on the shared encode fixture); only `hf_auto/live_runtime.rs`, the hub-probe and caches wiring, stays outside as live-network glue. 2026-11-07 (`larql doctor`): `doctor/` is brought UNDER the gate at the 90% default — every check is a pure function of injected facts; only `doctor/live_runtime.rs`, which gathers those facts from the OS, a child process and the network, stays outside.
